text:
Yara: Tiny idea  let's do a weekly chores lottery for kitchen duties. winner gets a prize (bragging rights). whos in? :raised_hand:
Ben: In. but prize better not be dish duty forever. :grimacing:
Sophie: I'll join if prize includes snack immunity one day. :cookie:
Tom: Suggestion: put everyone's name in a hat. or use code: ```/lottery "chores" "Yara" "Ben" "Sophie" "Tom" "Mika"```
Mika: Love a hat. also can we add a silent-disco hour on Fridays? earbud-friendly coding vibes. :headphones:
Yara: Silent disco is non-negotiable. who brings the playlist? :notes:
music-bot: Playlist suggestion: "Lo-fi Focus" queued. react with :thumbsup: to add. (auto)
Ben: Meme: https://cdn.example/memes/desk-chaos.png "When someone forgets to clean the microwave" :rofl:
Sophie: PSA: microwave etiquette - cover your food. the splatter is real. :pray:
Tom: Also FYI my desk plant (Fernie) achieved escape velocity this morning. if you find soil in the hallway, it's mine. :seedling:
Mika: Fernie update: found under meeting room table, reporting for replanting duty. :shovel:
Yara: Lottery code deployed: ```/lottery-run chores 1825001111``` - results in 10 mins. loser totes coffee for the team. stakes = caffeinated. :coffee:
ops-bot: Lottery started by Yara. Entries: Yara, Ben, Sophie, Tom, Mika. Winner announced in thread. (system)
Ben: Quick kudos: Sophie helped me debug the CSS meltdown yesterday. saved my sanity. :sparkles:
Sophie: thanks! team effort. also free coffee if you want to claim your kudos cup. :cup_with_straw:
music-bot: Voting results: add "Lo-fi Focus"? 6 yes, 1 no. Playlist added to Friday slot. (system)
Yara: Results: winner is Sophie! congrats, your prize = temporary snack immunity + the right to assign one micro-task. use it wisely. :tada:
Sophie: I will accept and use it to mandate donut day. you're welcome. :donut:
Tom: I nominate a microwave sticker that says: "Respect the heat, clean the seat". branding pending. :stuck_out_tongue:
ops-bot: Building note: badge rotation scheduled Sunday 10am. No access interruptions expected. (system)
